camera_interpolation: linear camera centres + rotation SLERP; actual Gaussian rendering at every frame
RGB: visible narrow-band composite of learned radiance
HSI: near-infrared false-colour composite of learned radiance
material: Separate class-share maps from visibility-weighted abundance grouped with a frozen training-view mapping; not physical area fractions

material_display.normalization: Each pixel: sum visibility-weighted endmember shares by mapped class, divided by accumulated opacity; fixed display scale 0–1
